title: Joe's St. Louis trip, sports, appetite and generosity
summary: Joe went to St. Louis to coax Louis off the boat, loved ball games and pool, ate well and sent money to Palao's sick family. She dislikes the unkind things said of him in books.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Somebody told me once that he went to St. Louis for a trip, I think just a short trip. Do you remember going there? Oh, yes. Yes. No, I didn't go with him.

You didn't go on those trips? Yeah. All the time Joe would take a trip like that. He went to St. Louis. He went to St. Louis. That's the time he brought Louis. He went to try to coax Louis to leave the boat. That's the time. And he made the short trip. I have a picture of you. Of Louis and Joe. And they stayed there quite a long time. But Joe liked sports. He would go to New York for the ball game. Well, somebody told me he liked the ball game. Oh, yes. He liked all the sports. He was crazy about ball game. And ball game and pool. I used to bring his dinner to the Dreamland. He liked the pool so well he wouldn't come home for dinner. He would call me up and tell me, bring his dinner over to the Dreamland. But he never ate anywhere but home. He wasn't a fella to eat sandwiches and all that. He wanted salad food all that time. Somebody told me he was a big eater. He was. He really did eat a lot. He was a big eater. And he liked good things and he liked nice things. He was crazy about sweets. And he didn't mind spending his money for it and for his friends. He was very liberal with his money with his friends. Because I've gone through his bank book and find out where he had sent money here to Palau. Palau. Oh, yes. The violin player. That's right. That's right. His whole family was sick. Joe would send money out of his salad. He would do that. And he wouldn't tell me anything until I'd look and see. Yeah. He'd send it. But it seemed so bad. The fellas didn't stick with him. Yeah, that's a shame. They didn't. And they didn't say nice things. Some things they said about him. I read a couple of books. They didn't say nice things about him. And he had a wonderful disposition. Nice personality. He liked a kid when he was a good year.
That's what I heard him like. He was a big joker.
